assign.outcome:
**Split vs add, two verbs and two gestures; the insert `+` stops eating a nested seam drag; the group toggle now on the bar too.**

![](split-twin.png)

- `Panel.restyle(from)` — copies `Panel.shared` minus `template seed text`, plus `grow`. Edge click (`split.js`) now commits `new Panel().restyle(item)`: the struck panel's own twin, empty, 50/50. The Workspace bar's `+` (FIRST in the bar, one minimal edit beside task C's concurrent viewport work) is `Workspace.add()`: a fresh `new Panel()` beside the focused panel, or — on a document root with nothing focused — a fresh section at the end (`new Panel().move(root)`, `sown()`'s own shape; not `root.divide()`, which would re-wrap every existing section once the root already holds more than one — measured and avoided).
- `insert.js`'s seam `+` no longer eats a NESTED split's outer seam drag: its stub now starts `0.7rem` in, not flush at 0 — the exact clearance `split.css`'s own `--clear` already uses for the identical grip-vs-overlay conflict. Its own-split behaviour (winning the click at ITS OWN interior gap) is untouched by design.
- The `group` toggle (`properties.js`'s rail control) is now also on the bar, for any split — one predicate in `toolbar.js`'s `word_pops()`.
- Proven headless, all green: split-twin (same tone/display/cols, empty template, grow 1/1); add beside a leaf and add on a document root (2→3 each, last child fresh); the nested seam drags 100px with insert's `+` genuinely hovered/active; the bar's group toggle flips `.panel-group`. Zero console errors on `/framework/ext/Panel/`, `/Workspace/`, `/playground/`.
- **Left open:** `page.js`'s `methods:` list wasn't extended for `restyle()` (page.js is out of this task's fences), so it won't get its own `doc/method/` page yet.
